title: Snowim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Snowim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Snowim is a ice-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Agility (A), Vitality (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Snowim
sections.content:
Location: Frozen Hearts - defeat Gargant.

Obtained from Frozen Hearts - defeat Gargant.

sections.title: Is the Snowim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (A), Vitality (B). A dedicated ice pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
